notes: Tri-mode 75% board with a 240×135 screen and a volume knob on the AJAZZ Windows-driver protocol (0C45:800A, product string "AULA-NOVA75"). The vendor configuration caps animations at 107 frames, fewer than the F108 Pro's 141. Brightness and speed have 7 steps (0–6).

usb.evidence: Official AULA NOVA75 driver Beta 1.0.0.2 config.xml mode 0 (0C45:800A "AULA-NOVA75", MI_00); menu enables macros, lighting, per-key, music and screen. Same protocol as the owner-verified AK820 MAX PLUS; not yet verified on a NOVA75.

2.4ghz.evidence: Official config.xml mode 2 (05AC:024F "2.4G Dongle", MI_03): the receiver's 32-byte protocol (sonix-dongle). menu_wireless disables the screen; OpenKey offers lighting, battery, sleep, key response and game mode there.

bluetooth.evidence: The official driver lists only the USB and 2.4 GHz modes.

knob.note: The volume knob is firmware-controlled; the official driver has no knob setting.

evidence: Official AULA NOVA75 driver Beta 1.0.0.2: config.xml (identities), layouts/rgb-keyboard.xml (menus, screen 240×135 ≤107 frames, brightness/speed max 6, 80 keys with key index = light index)
